Location comments: 111 acres claimed as "virgin" woodland. The site has some nice trees but the site was rather disappointing. It is an obvious stand of "mature" second growth from a field. Just one small ravine appeared to harbor the native climax composition with some mature hemlock, beech, maple, and a cucumber.
Measurer(s): Daniel Reed, Steve Galehouse, Will Blozan
